question:
Select the appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Opaque
solution:
The correct answer is: **Transparent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Opaque"** means not allowing light to pass through; it is something that is not transparent or clear. (अपारदर्शी)

 
 
• **Example:** The frosted glass on the window is **opaque** and prevents anyone from seeing inside.
 
 
 
• **"Transparent"** refers to something that allows light to pass through so that objects behind can be clearly seen. (पारदर्शी)
 
 
• **Example:** The **transparent **plastic sheet allowed us to see the contents inside the package.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"Opaque"** is **"Transparent"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Transparent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cloudy** (धुंधला): Not clear or transparent; filled with clouds or resembling a cloud.

 
 
• **Example:** The sky was **cloudy **before the heavy rain started.
 
 
 
• **Dull** (मंद): Lacking brightness or vividness; not lively.
 
 
• **Example:** The **dull **surface of the old mirror made it hard to see reflections.
 
 
 
• **Dark** (अंधकारमय): Having little or no light; black or deep in colour.
 
 
• **Example:** The room was **dark **after the power outage.
